title: What is the Best Kind of Yoga for Beginners?
titleZh: 对于初学者来说，最好的瑜伽类型是什么？
credits: Albert Stumm reported on this story for the Associated Press. John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: The activity called yoga means different things to different people around the world.
sentences.zh: 瑜伽这项活动世界各地不同的人对其有着不同的理解。

sentences.en: The word itself comes from the Sanskrit language and means “union.”
sentences.zh: 这个词本身源自梵语，意为“结合”。

sentences.en: For some, yoga is an exercise centered on mindful breathing and slow movement.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，瑜伽是一种以正念呼吸和缓慢动作为核心的锻炼。

sentences.en: For others, it is a series of difficult body movements and positioning designed to improve health and fitness.
sentences.zh: 对另一些人来说，它是一系列旨在增进健康和体能的难度较高的身体动作和姿势。

sentences.en: Still others consider yoga a spiritual exercise.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人把瑜伽视为一种精神修行。

sentences.en: And there are many people for whom yoga is a combination of all or some of these things.
sentences.zh: 还有许多人对瑜伽而言，是上述种种全部或部分内容的结合。

sentences.en: So, yoga takes many different forms around the world.
sentences.zh: 因此，瑜伽在世界各地呈现出多种不同的形式。

sentences.en: All kinds of yoga involve positions known as poses (asanas).
sentences.zh: 各种瑜伽都涉及被称为体式（asanas）的姿势。

sentences.en: But the positions and training can differ even under yoga methods, or styles, of the same name, including hatha, vinyasa, Iyengar and others.
sentences.zh: 然而，即便在名称相同的瑜伽流派或风格之下，其姿势和训练也可能有所不同，包括哈他瑜伽、维尼萨瑜伽、艾扬格瑜伽等。

sentences.en: So, what is the best kind of yoga training for a beginner?
sentences.zh: 那么，对初学者而言，最好的瑜伽训练是哪一种呢？

sentences.en: “The best is the one that works for you,” said Tim Senesi, who has been teaching yoga in Orange County, California, for 22 years.
sentences.zh: “最好的，就是适合你的那种，”蒂姆·森西说道，他在加利福尼亚州橙县已从事瑜伽教学22年。

sentences.en: “There are many different paths leading toward the same aim,” he added.
sentences.zh: “通往同一目标的道路有许多种，”他补充道。

sentences.en: Hatha, meaning “force,” describes any kind of yoga class involving asanas.
sentences.zh: 哈他，意为“力量”，泛指任何涉及体式的瑜伽课程。

sentences.en: A sun salutation, for example, is an important series of 12 asanas that begin many kinds of yoga classes.
sentences.zh: 例如，太阳致敬式是一系列重要的12个体式，许多瑜伽课程都以它开篇。

sentences.en: Training under the hatha name, however, is usually gentler than others and more centered on breathing exercises, called pranayama.
sentences.zh: 然而，以“哈他”之名进行的训练通常比其他流派更为温和，更侧重于被称为调息的呼吸练习。

sentences.en: Poses are held for a few breaths and students usually move more slowly.
sentences.zh: 体式通常保持几次呼吸的时间，学生们的动作通常更为缓慢。

sentences.en: Hatha can be good for beginners who are looking to relax while improving flexibility and balance.
sentences.zh: 哈他瑜伽适合那些希望在提升柔韧性和平衡性的同时放松身心的初学者。

sentences.en: Another style, yin, pays even more attention to recovery by working to stretch the muscles’ connective tissue.
sentences.zh: 另一种流派阴瑜伽更加注重恢复，通过拉伸肌肉的结缔组织来达到这一目的。

sentences.en: Students hold poses for 5 minutes or more, permitting the body to settle into a pose rather than pushing it.
sentences.zh: 学生们会保持体式5分钟或更长时间，让身体自然沉入体式，而非强行推进。

sentences.en: A more difficult, flowing form of yoga is known as vinyasa.
sentences.zh: 一种更为困难、流畅的瑜伽形式被称为维尼萨瑜伽。

sentences.en: It mixes movement with breath over a series of asanas.
sentences.zh: 它在一系列体式中将动作与呼吸相配合。

sentences.en: Some higher-level vinyasa classes move at a rate of one movement per breath.
sentences.zh: 一些高级的维尼亚萨瑜伽课程以每一次呼吸配合一个动作的速度进行。

sentences.en: In the United States, these classes are often called Flow or Power yoga.
sentences.zh: 在美国，这类课程通常被称为流动瑜伽或力量瑜伽。

sentences.en: They can be good for people who are more athletic.
sentences.zh: 它们适合更具运动天赋的人。

sentences.en: Still, teachers suggest that even athletic students start with a beginner level.
sentences.zh: 不过，教师们建议，即便是擅长运动的学生也应从入门级别开始。

sentences.en: “I wouldn’t really encourage them to start in a higher level vinyasa flow class because they’re not going to have the foundation to move safely through that,” said Anne Van Valkenburg, of Lanai, Hawaii.
sentences.zh: “我不会真的鼓励他们从更高级的维尼亚萨流动瑜伽课程开始，因为他们缺乏安全完成这些动作的基础。”来自夏威夷拉奈安的安妮·范·瓦尔肯堡说道。

sentences.en: She has been training yoga teachers in a mix of methods for 18 years.
sentences.zh: 她从事瑜伽教师培训已有18年，采用多种方法相结合的教学。

sentences.en: Ashtanga yoga is similar to vinyasa.
sentences.zh: 阿斯汤加瑜伽与维尼亚萨瑜伽相似。

sentences.en: However, ashtanga involves a set series of poses that students repeat day after day, often going at their own speed.
sentences.zh: 然而，阿斯汤加瑜伽包含一套固定的动作序列，学生会日复一日地重复练习，通常按照自己的节奏进行。

sentences.en: As students get stronger and more skilled, they move up to a higher series with more difficult poses.
sentences.zh: 随着学生变得更强壮、更熟练，他们会进入难度更高的更高序列。

sentences.en: Iyengar style involves the same poses as vinyasa, but classes usually move at a slower pace.
sentences.zh: 艾扬格瑜伽与维尼亚萨瑜伽采用相同的动作，但课程通常节奏较慢。

sentences.en: However, the poses are not necessarily easier.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些动作未必更容易。

sentences.en: Iyengar yoga pays special attention to carefully moving or aligning parts of the body.
sentences.zh: 艾扬格瑜伽特别注重仔细地移动或调整身体的各个部位。

sentences.en: Poses are held for longer and students often use supportive equipment during the exercise.
sentences.zh: 动作会保持更长时间，学生在练习过程中常常借助辅助器材。

sentences.en: Iyengar is especially good for people recovering from injuries.
sentences.zh: 艾扬格瑜伽对从伤病中恢复的人来说尤其有益。

sentences.en: It can also be a good fit for physically active people who want to get the basics of yoga before moving into different styles.
sentences.zh: 它也适合那些在转向其他流派之前想要掌握瑜伽基础的身体活跃者。

sentences.en: These days, teachers often mix different yoga methods in a single class.
sentences.zh: 如今，教师们常常在一堂课上融合不同的瑜伽方法。

sentences.en: And many classes are not named under any traditional method.
sentences.zh: 而且许多课程并不归属于任何传统流派。

sentences.en: The AP suggests that if you are interested in starting to practice yoga, you should look for a beginner series.
sentences.zh: 美联社建议，如果你对开始练习瑜伽感兴趣，你应该寻找一套入门级课程。

sentences.en: But if you cannot find one that is right, do not worry.
sentences.zh: 但如果你找不到合适的，也不必担心。

sentences.en: Most teachers are happy to have beginners in their classes and will alter the training to meet the needs of students new to yoga.
sentences.zh: 大多数老师都很乐意接收初学者，并会调整训练以满足初学瑜伽学生的需求。

sentences.en: Most of all, try a few classes until you find the method or teacher who is a good fit for you.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，多试几节课，直到找到适合你的方法或老师。

sentences.en: “I feel sad when someone tries yoga once or twice and they’re like, ‘Eh, I don’t like it,’” Van Valkenburg said, adding, “there’s just so much out there that you might be missing...”
sentences.zh: “当有人尝试一两次瑜伽后说‘唉，我不喜欢’时，我会感到难过，”范·瓦尔肯堡说道，并补充说，“外面的东西实在太多了，你可能会错过……”

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·拉塞尔。

the ability of joints and muscles to move through a range of motion
